title: Evaluation pack manifest
description: A versioned set of queries, fixtures or snapshot references, judgments, policy assertions, and budgets. Cases and judgments are named as separate files and are never inlined here.

version.description: Pack version. A pack is versioned independently of the schema it conforms to.

profile.description: Profile the pack expects to be resolved against.

sources.description: Directory of fixture sources or snapshot references.

transcripts.description: Directory of recorded adapter protocol transcripts replayed instead of live calls.

network_access.description: Absent or false means the pack must run with network access disabled. Only a live health pack sets it.

thresholds.description: Absolute gate thresholds recorded in the pack. On the first run there is no baseline, so these are absolute; afterwards they become regression bounds derived from measured distributions.

sensitivity_ceiling.description: No candidate in any case may cross this.

baseline.description: Provenance of the thresholds above: when they were measured and on what. A threshold with no record of where it came from is folklore, and the first thing anyone asks of a failing gate is whether the bar was ever justified.

note.description: What was measured, on what host, and why the budgets sit where they do.

relative_path.description: Slash-separated path relative to the pack directory. Absolute paths and backslashes are refused so a pack is portable.
